Security, site management, backups

Keep your site secure
and backed up.

Built-in security and backups that run themselves, so you can focus on building.

Stop threats before they reach your site.

A real-time firewall with automatic rule updates blocks attacks, and virtual patching shields your sites from known vulnerabilities before a formal fix is released.

Prevent unauthorized access with 2FA.

Two-factor authentication keeps your WordPress sites safe from credential-based attacks.

Recover anything with one click.

Daily backups run automatically, so your data is always safe and retrievable when you need it.

Monitor site heath and performance from one dashboard.

Track site health, uptime, and performance from one dashboard.

Kadence WP FAQ

Questions, answered.

Want to know more? Check out our FAQs for answers to common questions. Talk to a human — usually under 4 hours.

Kadence is WordPress site builder; a platform that combines a premium theme, page builder, WooCommerce tools, security, backups, and memberships in one ecosystem. It’s designed for anyone who wants full control over their WordPress site without stitching together plugins from multiple vendors. As part of Nexcess, Kadence is backed by decades of experience building tools for serious web professionals.

Kadence is built for anyone running a serious WordPress site, from first-time builders to agencies managing dozens of client sites. It’s a natural fit for agencies, ecommerce stores, course creators, nonprofits, membership sites, and businesses that have outgrown entry-level tools and need a platform that scales with them.

No. Kadence is built so you can design and customize your site visually without writing a line of code. Advanced options are available for developers and agencies who want deeper control, but you don’t need them to build something professional.

Yes, and it’s built for it. Kadence Elite includes white labeling and Kadence Central for multi-site management, making it the tier most agencies and freelancers reach for.

Most WordPress tools make you choose between design flexibility and performance. Kadence doesn’t. It’s rated #1 for web accessibility, has powered 600,000+ websites, and covers design, ecommerce, security, and memberships in a single ecosystem—without the bloat that comes with piecing together tools from separate vendors.

Yes. Kadence Pro and Elite include Shop Kit for WooCommerce, with purpose-built store enhancement tools covering checkout, product galleries, attribute swatches, upsells, memberships, and more. It’s built for stores that need to perform, not just look good.

Yes. Kadence runs on any WordPress host. There are no hosting requirements or dependencies.
